title: M09A Relay Trust and Node Pairing Ceremony
purpose: Implement Node identity pairing ceremony, HMAC-SHA256 request signing, node trust allowlists, and node revocation for secure inter-node execution.
problem: Multi-node coordination requires mutual node authentication and trust boundaries before accepting execution requests or sharing capability inventories.

included: 4-step node pairing ceremony (Discovery -> Challenge -> Verification -> Token Enrollment)
HMAC-SHA256 request signature verification and timestamp replay protection
Persistent node trust store at data/nodes/node-trust-store.json with tier levels
Node revocation mechanism for revoking compromised or retired nodes

acceptanceCriteria.description: Nodes successfully complete the 4-step challenge-response pairing ceremony and acquire trust tokens
Inter-node requests are signed with HMAC-SHA256 and verified against node secret tokens
Requests from untrusted, unpaired, or expired nodes are explicitly rejected with code UNTRUSTED_NODE
Revoked nodes are immediately rejected from inter-node execution and bus subscriptions
